title: Fake holiday villa websites prompt warning ｜ 虚假假日别墅网站引发警示

sents.en: During the British winter, the thought of two weeks in a coastal villa with soul-stirring views of the sea and a huge pool to enjoy is enough to offset the labor until the holidays start.
sents.cn: 在英国冬季，想到能在海滨别墅住上两周，欣赏令人心驰神往的海景、享受巨大的泳池，就足以抵消节前劳作的辛苦。

sents.en: For a growing number of people, however, their yearly break is turning into a nightmare as they find that the property they have paid thousands for does not exist and the website through which they booked it has disappeared.
sents.cn: 然而，对越来越多人来说，他们的年度休假正变成一场噩梦——他们发现花数千英镑预订的房产根本不存在，而用来预订的网站也消失了。

sents.en: Consumers have been warned to be aware of the potential for deception in this market, which is far from uncommon.
sents.cn: 消费者已被告诫，要警惕这一市场中潜在的欺诈，而这绝非罕见。

sents.en: In 2017 there were 1,632 cases of reported "villa fraud", with victims losing an average of £2,052, according to Action Fraud, the national center for reporting such frauds.
sents.cn: 据举报此类欺诈的全国中心ActionFraud数据，2017年有1,632起报案的"别墅诈骗"案，受害者平均损失2,052英镑。

sents.en: "Millions of pounds are lost each year by defrauded holidaymakers," says Sean Tipton of the Association of British Travel Agents (ABTA).
sents.cn: 英国旅行代理商协会（ABTA）的肖恩∙蒂普顿说："被欺诈的度假者每年损失数百万英镑。"

sents.en: The problem has ballooned in the last 10 years, with frauds becoming more and more sophisticated.
sents.cn: 过去10年这一问题急剧膨胀，欺诈也变得愈发精密。

sents.en: The fake websites have authentic-sounding names involving a mix of keywords, typically including the place name, "summer", "villas" or "rentals".
sents.cn: 虚假网站的名字听上去很真，混合了关键词，通常包括地名、"summer"、"villas"或"rentals"。

sents.en: Details of legitimate villas are often stolen from other sites.
sents.cn: 合法别墅的详情常被从其他网站盗取。

sents.en: "When the fraudsters first started it was unsophisticated·the websites looked amateur and there wasn't a lot of effort," says Tipton.
sents.cn: 蒂普顿说："欺诈者刚起步时手法粗糙——网站看起来很业余，也没花多少力气。

sents.en: "Now they are clever.
sents.cn: 如今他们很聪明，大量剽窃合法网站并换个网站名。

sents.en: They extensively rip off legitimate websites and use a different website name.
sents.cn: 他们会放上销售团队的照片，甚至可能是纽约某个不入流的演员被列为销售主管。

sents.en: They'll have pictures of a sales team and it might be a poor actor in New York that is down as their head of sales."
Fraudsters target popular seaside destinations for British tourists visiting Spain where prices can soar if demand exceeds supply.
sents.cn: 欺诈者瞄准英国游客赴西班牙的热门海滨目的地，那里若需求超过供给，价格便会飙升。

sents.en: Prices are kept within reasonable ranges to avoid arousing suspicion.
sents.cn: 他们把价格保持在合理区间以避免引起怀疑。

sents.en: "A villa might cost £5,000 elsewhere and they will offer it at say £3,500.
sents.cn: 蒂普顿说："一套别墅别处可能卖5,000英镑，他们却标价约3,500英镑。

sents.en: But a bit of a giveaway is that the villa will be cheaper than on other websites and there's unlimited availability," says Tipton.
sents.cn: 但一个破绽是，这别墅比其他网站便宜，而且永远有房。

sents.en: Fraudsters also invest in pay-per-click advertising to feature at the top of search engines when people type in phrases such as "Spanish seaside villas".
sents.cn: "欺诈者还投放在线点击付费广告，让人们在输入"西班牙海滨别墅"等短语时，其网站出现在搜索引擎顶部。

sents.en: With such a degree of professionalism, how can consumers find out if the website they're looking to book with is trustworthy?
sents.cn: 专业程度如此之高，消费者如何能弄清想预订的网站是否可靠？

sents.en: "When people book holiday villas they are doing so through rose-colored glasses," says Tony Neate, chief executive of Get Safe Online.
sents.cn: "GetSafeOnline"首席执行官托尼∙尼特说："人们预订假日别墅时，是戴着玫瑰色眼镜看的。

sents.en: "They should be Googling the property, and looking on websites like Google Maps and StreetView to see if it's there.
sents.cn: "他说："他们应该在谷歌上搜索该房产，并在谷歌地图、街景等网站上查看它是否属实。

sents.en: Also, speak to the person you're booking the villa with on a landline phone, as fraudsters tend to only use mobiles." He also suggests asking someone not going on the holiday to have a look at the website.
sents.cn: 还有，用座机电话与为你预订别墅的人交谈，因为欺诈者往往只用手机。"他还建议让不打算去度假的人帮忙看看网站："他们可能发现你没注意的问题。

sents.en: "They might spot problems you don't spot." Another potential red flag is being asked to pay by bank transfer.
sents.cn: "另一个潜在危险信号是被要求用银行转账付款。

sents.en: "The problem is that when the money leaves your account it's in theirs straightaway and it's very hard to track it," says Barclays Bank head of digital safety, Jodie Gilbert.
sents.cn: 巴克莱银行数字安全主管乔迪∙吉尔伯特说："问题是钱一离开你的账户就立刻进了他们的账户，很难追踪。

sents.en: "We generally recommend other forms of payment, like credit card."
sents.cn: 我们通常建议用其他方式付款，比如信用卡。"

sents.en: Little seems to be known about these fraudsters.
sents.cn: 对这些欺诈者似乎所知甚少。

sents.en: "There is no way to definitely know who they are," says Neate. "It could be anyone.
sents.cn: 尼特说："无法确切知道他们是谁，可能是任何人，可能是你的邻居，也可能是俄罗斯的有组织犯罪。

sents.en: It could be your next-door neighbor or organized crime in Russia." Action Fraud says people should ensure the company renting the villa is a member of a recognized trade body such as ABTA.
sents.cn: "ActionFraud提醒人们，应确保出租别墅的公司是ABTA等公认行业机构的成员。

sents.en: "By working with industry partners such as ABTA and Get Safe Online, we are able to issue alerts about the latest threats they should be aware of.
sents.cn: "通过与ABTA、GetSafeOnline等行业伙伴合作，我们能够及时发布他们应警惕的最新威胁警报。

sents.en: If you believe you have fallen victim to fraud or cyber-crime, please report it to Action Fraud," it adds.
sents.cn: 如果你认为自己已成为欺诈或网络犯罪的受害者，请向ActionFraud举报，"该机构补充道。

sents.en: ABTA says it is trying to combat the issue by running public awareness campaigns.
sents.cn: ABTA表示正试图通过开展公众意识活动来应对这一问题。

sents.en: "It's a growing problem and people can't stop fraudsters being dishonest," says Tipton.
sents.cn: 蒂普顿说："这是个日益严重的问题，人们无法阻止欺诈者行骗。

sents.en: "They're still going to do it.
sents.cn: 他们仍会这么做。

sents.en: It's not impossible to stop but as it's internet-based it's harder to pursue."
sents.cn: 并非完全无法阻止，但因为它基于网络，更难追查。"

sents.en: Nick Cooper, the founder and co-owner of villa booking company Villa Plus, estimates his company has uncovered more than 200 fake villa websites over the past two years, and doesn't believe enough is being done.
sents.cn: 别墅预订公司VillaPlus的创始人兼共同所有者尼克∙库珀估计，过去两年其公司已发现超过200个虚假别墅网站，并认为各方做得还远远不够。

sents.en: "It is hopeless to report fake villa websites to the internet giants who host them," he says.
sents.cn: 他说："向托管这些虚假别墅网站的互联网巨头举报毫无希望。

sents.en: "I found it impossible to speak to anyone.
sents.cn: 我发现根本联系不上任何人。

sents.en: Also, once one bank account gets reported, they simply use another."
sents.cn: 而且，一旦某个银行账户被举报，他们就换用另一个。"

sents.en: For now the only way to stop fraudsters appears ultimately to lie in the hands of the consumer.
sents.cn: 目前，阻止欺诈者的唯一办法最终似乎掌握在消费者手中。

sents.en: "When people book their holidays they get so emotionally involved, and when they find that villa at a good price with availability in peak season, they are an easy target," says Cooper.
sents.cn: 库珀说："人们预订假期时情绪投入太深，当他们在旺季找到价格合适又有房的别墅时，就成了容易上当的目标。

sents.en: "The public has to learn to be far more aware they are a target for these sort of frauds.
sents.cn: 公众必须学会更清楚地意识到自己是这类欺诈的目标。

sents.en: But it's not just the financial cost.
sents.cn: 但这不只是金钱损失。

sents.en: "A family will turn up at a villa and find out it doesn't exist or the owner doesn't know who you are," says Tipton.
sents.cn: "蒂普顿说："一家人到了别墅却发现它根本不存在，或房东根本不认识你。

sents.en: "The problem then is you have to find accommodation at short notice.
sents.cn: 问题随之而来：你不得不在短时间内找住处。

sents.en: It can be incredibly expensive but it's the emotional cost, too."
sents.cn: 这可能极其昂贵，但还有情感上的代价。"

sents.en: Carla O'Shaughnessy from Sydenham was searching last year for a good deal to book a villa in Majorca for a summer break for the family.
sents.cn: 来自西德纳姆的卡拉∙奥肖内西去年正在寻找划算的交易，想为全家夏日度假在马略卡岛订一套别墅。

sents.en: "I was comparing prices online and found one that came in a bit cheaper than others," says O'Shaughnessy.
sents.cn: 奥肖内西说："我在网上比价，发现一家比别家稍便宜些。

sents.en: She emailed the company via its website, asking how far the villa was from the airport and about local restaurants.
sents.cn: "她通过网站给公司发邮件，询问别墅离机场多远，以及当地餐馆情况。

sents.en: "They came back with believable answers; it was all very friendly and professional," she says.
sents.cn: "他们回复得可信，一切都很友好、专业，"她说。

sents.en: Happy with the responses, O'Shaughnessy paid the full amount of £3,000 via bank transfer into the travel agent's account and then forgot about it until a month before the booking.
sents.cn: 对回复满意后，奥肖内西通过银行转账将3,000英镑全额付进旅行社账户，随后便不再理会，直到预订前一个月才想起。

sents.en: "I tried logging on to the website and couldn't," she recalls.
sents.cn: "我试着登录网站，却登不上去，"她回忆道。

sents.en: "I Googled the agent's name and there were lots of complaints about him being a fraudster.
sents.cn: "我用谷歌搜索了那个代理的名字，发现很多投诉说他是欺诈者。

sents.en: If only I'd Googled before but I never thought of it." Although she found another villa in time for their holiday, she admits she was much more cautious.
sents.cn: 要是我之前搜一下就好了，但我从没想过。"尽管她及时找到了另一套别墅度假，她承认自己谨慎多了。

sents.en: "I paid through a secure third-party site and had phone conversations with the agent.
sents.cn: "我通过安全的第三方网站付款，并和代理通了电话。

sents.en: But I wasn't able to relax until we turned up and I had the keys." 。"
sents.cn: 但我直到我们到达、拿到钥匙才放心下来
